subject.title: fix(google): repair legacy provider catalog config

question: Should this PR be allowed to close the linked Google legacy-provider issue even though it fixes the catalog migration but not the fallback idle-timeout behavior?
rationale: The code fix is focused, but GitHub will close the canonical issue on merge and the issue body contains a separate runtime failure-mode request that this diff does not implement.

options.title: Split fallback tracking before merge
options.body: Remove or adjust the closing reference and link a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fallback/idle-timeout behavior, then merge this migration once checks pass.

options.title: Expand this PR
options.body: Add the fail-fast or fallback continuation behavior plus tests here so the closing reference accurately covers the whole issue.

options.title: Accept migration as sufficient
options.body: Merge with the closing reference and treat the migration as resolving the practical user blocker despite the remaining fallback failure-mode request.

recommendation.title: Split fallback tracking before merge
recommendation.body: Remove or adjust the closing reference and link a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fallback/idle-timeout behavior, then merge this migration once checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent Google provider ownership history and is the best available owner for deciding whether to split or close the linked Google-provider issue.
